description: Design system foundation: swap font to Inter, rewrite App.css with new CSS variables and all restyled classes (dark sidebar, lime accent, new card/button/pill/utilization styles), update DashboardLayout.jsx with new sidebar structure (vendor info row, Documents link, SWITCH ROLE section), and update shared UI components StatCard.jsx (dark tone + badge prop) and StatusPill.jsx CSS classes. This FEAT is the dependency for all page implementations in FEAT-002.
steps: 1. Rewrite src/index.css: replace @import with Inter font (https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap), change font-family on :root to 'Inter', remove h1/h2/h3/strong Manrope override. Keep all existing CSS variables (--green, --green-dark, --cream, --line, --muted, --shadow) unchanged.

2. Rewrite src/App.css entirely. Add new CSS variables at top: --sidebar-bg:#111111, --sidebar-text:#888888, --lime:#C8F000, --lime-dark:#a8cc00, --page-bg:#F5F5F5, --white:#FFFFFF, --text-primary:#111111, --text-secondary:#666666, --border:#E8E8E8, --card-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), --radius-card:16px, --radius-btn:100px, --sidebar-width:210px. KEEP existing admin vars --green, --green-dark, --line, --muted, --shadow. Restyle .sidebar to width:210px, background:var(--sidebar-bg), color:var(--sidebar-text). Restyle .sidebar nav a.active to background:var(--lime), color:var(--text-primary), border-radius:var(--radius-btn), remove old border-left. Update .main and .topbar margin-left from 250px to 210px. Add .sidebar-vendor-info and .sidebar-vendor-info__avatar (lime circle) classes. Add .sidebar-switch-link class. Add .stat-card--dark (black bg, white text) and .stat-card__badge (lime pill). Add .vendor-dashboard-grid (65fr/35fr grid). Add .utilization-bar, .utilization-bar__track, .utilization-bar__fill--rent (#4B8EF1), .utilization-bar__fill--avail (var(--lime)), .utilization-bar__fill--maint (#FFB800). Add .pending-list, .pending-item, .btn-accept (lime), .btn-decline (gray). Add .status--available (lime bg, #111 text), .status--on_rent (#1a2e4a bg, white text), .status--maintenance (#FF9800 bg, white text). Update .primary-button to background:var(--lime), color:#111, border-radius:var(--radius-btn). Update .primary-button:hover to background:var(--lime-dark). Update .toggle-switch input:checked + track to background:var(--lime). Update body background to var(--page-bg) i.e. #F5F5F5. Update .profile-hero to background:linear-gradient(120deg,#111,#222) and .profile-avatar to background:var(--lime), color:#111. Keep ALL existing class names intact (admin pages use them).

3. Update src/components/layout/DashboardLayout.jsx: (a) Add FileText to lucide-react imports. (b) Add /documents link to vendorSections array: ['/documents','Documents',FileText]. (c) Add vendor info row JSX above <nav> when !isAdmin: div.sidebar-vendor-info > div.sidebar-vendor-info__avatar (first letter of user.name) + div > div.sidebar-vendor-info__name (user.name) + div.sidebar-vendor-info__role ('Vendor'). (d) Add SWITCH ROLE section at bottom of vendor nav (after all vendorSection links, before sidebar-footer): span.sidebar-section-label 'SWITCH ROLE' + three span.sidebar-switch-link elements (Users icon + 'Customer', IdCard icon + 'Driver', ShieldCheck icon + 'Admin') — these are display-only spans, not NavLinks. All other logic (realtime, toast, logout, mobile, topbar) stays unchanged.

4. Update src/components/ui/StatCard.jsx: add optional badge prop and support tone='dark'. When tone==='dark', add class stat-card--dark to
. Render badge inside as {badge} when badge is truthy. Add stat-card__icon--dark CSS class (in App.css step 2): background:#222, color:var(--lime).

5. Verify src/components/ui/StatusPill.jsx needs no change — it already uses value.toLowerCase() to derive CSS class, so status values AVAILABLE, ON_RENT, MAINTENANCE will map to .status--available, .status--on_rent, .status--maintenance automatically once the CSS is added in step 2.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes with zero errors
Sidebar background is #111111 for both admin and vendor views
Active nav link shows lime (#C8F000) pill background with black text
Vendor sidebar shows vendor info row (lime avatar circle, name, 'Vendor' subtitle) above nav links
Vendor nav includes Documents link with FileText icon
SWITCH ROLE section appears at bottom of vendor nav with three non-clickable role entries
Font is Inter across the app (verify in browser DevTools computed styles)
Primary buttons are lime (#C8F000) with black text and pill shape (border-radius:100px)
Toggle switches turn lime when checked
StatusPill renders lime for AVAILABLE, dark blue for ON_RENT, orange for MAINTENANCE
findings: CSS class names match plan exactly. sidebar-vendor-info and sidebar-switch-link are new classes added in App.css. stat-card--dark and stat-card__badge are in App.css. DashboardLayout uses inline style for SWITCH ROLE wrapper margin-top:auto to push it to bottom (no new class needed). StatusPill needs no changes — value.toLowerCase() maps correctly to .status--available, .status--on_rent, .status--maintenance. The logout button in sidebar still uses .logout class — FEAT-002 pages can rely on all CSS variables (--lime, --lime-dark, --sidebar-bg, --radius-btn, --radius-card, --page-bg, --card-shadow, --sidebar-width). Documents page route is /documents and link is wired in DashboardLayout vendorSections.
